2607.01942.title: Atomic Task Graph: A Unified Framework for Agentic Planning and Execution
2607.01942.paper_summary: LLM-based agents have shown strong potential for solving complex multi-step tasks, yet existing performance improvements often rely on either scaling to larger backbone models or task-specific fine-tuning. The former incurs substantial computational costs, while the latter typically generalizes poorly across different tasks. Although prompt-based control is training-free and broadly applicable, existing methods still leave input-output dependencies between subtasks implicit in textual trajectories, making verified intermediate results difficult to reuse. To address these limitations, we propose Atomic Task Graph (ATG), a unified control framework for planning and execution. Specifically, ATG maintains an explicit graph to expose dependencies and support reuse. During planning, it recursively decomposes a high-level task into subtasks, forming a sequence of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) whose evolution can be traced. During execution, the dependencies exposed by ATG allow independent branches to be executed in parallel, thereby improving execution efficiency. When failures are detected, ATG leverages the graph evolution history to localize the error source and repair only the affected region, preserving validated regions unchanged. Experiments show that ATG consistently outperforms strong baselines in success rate and execution efficiency across three interactive benchmarks using only 7B-8B backbones.
2607.01942.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於模型的代理顯示出解決複雜多步驟任務的強大潛力，然而現有的性能提升通常依賴於擴展到更大的骨幹模型或特定任務的微調。前者會產生大量的計算成本，而後者通常在不同任務之間的泛化效果不佳。雖然基於提示的控制是無需訓練且廣泛適用的，但現有方法仍然使得子任務之間的輸入輸出依賴關係隱含在文本軌跡中，這使得驗證的中間結果難以重用。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了原子任務圖（Atomic Task Graph, ATG），這是一個統一的計劃和執行控制框架。具體而言，ATG 維護一個明確的圖來揭示依賴關係並支持重用。在計劃過程中，它遞歸地將高層任務分解為子任務，形成一系列有向無環圖（DAG），其演變可以被追踪。在執行過程中，ATG 揭示的依賴關係允許獨立的分支並行執行，從而提高執行效率。當檢測到故障時，ATG 利用圖的演變歷史來定位錯誤來源，並僅修復受影響的區域，保持已驗證的區域不變。實驗顯示，ATG 在成功率和執行效率方面始終超越強基準，僅使用 7B-8B 的骨幹。
